data.name: Jillane
data.gender_notes: Jillane is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English 'gyllan' meaning 'to shine'. The second part may be derived from the Old English 'ana' meaning 'one' or the Old French 'an' meaning 'graceful' or 'grace'. The name Jillane carries the meaning “Gentle stream or radiant one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jillane usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle stream or radiant one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gentle flow of spiritual energy and the radiant light of inner wisdom.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jillane total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
